notes: This is the cover page of the sitting: motto, coat of arms, title block, the presiding officer and the secretaries, then the attendance roll. NO speech is printed on it, so utterance_starts is empty and any speaker the parser reports on this page is a false positive. There is no running dateline row here (the date appears inside the title block instead), and no page number is printed. I listed 'PRESENTES:' and 'AUSENTES, CON AVISO:' as headings because they are printed bold as the roll's own headings; a maintainer may prefer to count them as furniture, since they head a list and not a section of debate. The bold personal names in the title block are set in a heavier weight than the surrounding words, which is decoration, not a speaker label. Typographic defects, printed exactly so: 'JuanHéctorEstrada' with no spaces, 'señor D.José Lepere' with no space after 'D.', and the motto opening '"2014 -Año de Homenaje' with the space on the wrong side of the dash. The roll lists 'ROJKES de ALPEROVICH' and 'NEGRE DE ALONSO' with inconsistent capitalisation of the particle.
